landing.title: BIL Electronic Journal
landing.subtitle: Grades, SOR/SOCH, activity and behavior — in one modern ecosystem.

features.gradesText: The teacher sets the maximum themselves — 10, 20, 30. Percentages and term grades are calculated automatically.
features.activityText: A dedicated 1–10 metric for student activity in each subject.
features.behaviorText: A separate category: praise and warnings, kept apart from grades.
features.classesText: Students are organized strictly by class — clean and secure structure.
